column1: # NERD's Hagi Wii/GameCube layer: statically recompiled into main, Hagi stands in for
# the GameCube hardware (GX -> Vulkan with SPIR-V generated at run time).
# Renders with Vulkan: main imports 98 vk* functions; the host implements them on Metal (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m).
# Only main, subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) and sdk are loaded.
# main imports Vulkan, not NVN: the host's Vulkan layer (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m). Hagi generates its GX shaders as SPIR-V at run time.
# NPDM system resource 8 MB. The game calls SetHeapSize for a 2.64 GB heap (0xa8e00000), so the heap region is 2.75 GB.
# The movie player's StandardAllocator initializes with virtual address memory in the 1.75 GB alias region
# after the SDK's node area (cut from 1 GB to 62 MB in dm/tools/sdk_patches.py for this SDK 14.3.0 build).
# NERD's Hagi maps the 32-bit GameCube address space (0x100200000 bytes = 4.002 GB) via AllocateAddressRegion,
# requiring a 5.25 GB alias region and 9 GB guest reservation.

column2: Pikmin 2 has no NVN shaders (its SPIR-V shaders go through the Vulkan layer)
